Do you still dance at all?

sentences.zh: 嗯，有机会的话会——我可能很快又要演音乐剧了。

sentences.zh: 《九》，你在《九》里表现得很棒。

sentences.en: I went – thank you.
sentences.zh: 我去看了——谢谢你。

sentences.en: I loved making that movie,
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢拍那部电影，

sentences.zh: 为了那部戏我又回去练了大概六个月的舞。

sentences.zh: 所以我一直在找机会回去跳舞。

sentences.en: That's great.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Wow, so you don't have the wear and tear on a person's body of 17 years of being on your toes.
sentences.zh: 哇，那你身上应该没有那种跳了17年芭蕾的人所留下的身体磨损吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有啊。

sentences.en: Like, do you have any kind of like –
sentences.zh: 比如，你有没有那种——

sentences.en: Do your toes still hurt?
sentences.zh: 你的脚趾还会疼吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: No, but I mean, I got used to that.
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，我已经习惯了。

sentences.zh: 你知道，当你脚趾流血，指甲——指甲脱落的时候。

sentences.zh: 它们会变黑，然后脱落，但你还得继续跳舞，保持微笑。

sentences.en: And the discipline that it gives you, it helped me a lot because I started to work as an actress so young,
sentences.zh: 那种训练带给我的纪律性，对我帮助很大，因为我做演员的时候年纪很小，

sentences.en: and I had the discipline from that that was so much harder than anything I have done.
sentences.zh: 而我从芭蕾中学到的纪律性，比我后来做过的任何事都要严苛。

sentences.en: I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 我肯定。

sentences.en: I can't believe that.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信。

sentences.en: You know, you talked a little bit about – sort of just to swing back to like what's important and stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你刚才提到——我们转回来说说什么是重要的之类的话题。

sentences.en: And I – so both you and your partner are film actors and actors at, you know,
sentences.zh: 你和你的伴侣都是电影演员，而且是，你知道的，

sentences.en: at the highest level and very much in demand.
sentences.zh: 处于最高水平且非常抢手的演员。

sentences.en: You've made lots of filMs.
sentences.zh: 你们拍了很多电影。

sentences.en: And yet now you've started a family, and I presume that you still live in Spain, yeah?
sentences.zh: 然而现在你们组建了家庭，我猜你们还是住在西班牙，对吧？

sentences.en: Or that you moved back.
sentences.zh: 或者说你们搬回去了。

sentences.en: Like, you spent very many years where you were doing like – it seemed like you did so many films,
sentences.zh: 你曾有许多年都在——看起来你拍了那么多的电影，

sentences.en: and I listed off all the awards and nominations.
sentences.zh: 我列举了你所有的奖项和提名。

sentences.en: And yet now do you find yourself – have you put that in a different place now?
sentences.zh: 但现在你是否发现——你把这些放在了不同的位置？

sentences.en: Like now that you've moved and you live in Europe and you don't live here in Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 比如现在你搬到了欧洲，不再住在洛杉矶，

sentences.en: and you've kind of – do you feel that you've been able to carve out a kind of a different life?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得你已经能够开辟出一种不同的生活了？

sentences.en: Very different.
sentences.zh: 非常不同。

sentences.en: Very different.
sentences.zh: 非常不同。

sentences.en: Where the total priority, the number one priority is the family.
sentences.zh: 在那里，家庭是绝对的首要任务，是第一要务。

sentences.en: And also most of my family, mom and sisters, and most of them are there in Spain.
sentences.zh: 而且我的大部分家人，我妈妈和姐妹们，她们大多都在西班牙。

sentences.en: My brother and nephew are here in L.A.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥和侄子在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: and I miss them so much.
sentences.zh: 我非常想念他们。

sentences.en: But, I mean, life always brings us here, like maybe in the summer, Christmas or both,
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，生活总会把我们带到这里，比如夏天、圣诞节或者两个时候都来，

sentences.en: and come here for work.
sentences.zh: 为了工作来到这里。

sentences.en: And I lived here for 15 years in L.A.
sentences.zh: 我在洛杉矶住了15年，

sentences.en: and I loved it,
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这里，

sentences.en: but we just wanted to be there raising the children because family is very important for us.
sentences.zh: 但我们还是想在那里抚养孩子，因为家庭对我们来说非常重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，当然。

sentences.en: What's the atmosphere like there where you live in Spain with respect to Hollywood
sentences.zh: 你住在西班牙那边，与好莱坞相比，氛围是怎样的？

sentences.en: and the media and fame and paparazzi and all that kind of stuff?
sentences.zh: 还有媒体、名气、狗仔队以及诸如此类的事情？

sentences.en: Can you live a very sort of normal, in quotes, life there as opposed to here?
sentences.zh: 在那里，你是否能过上一种所谓的“正常”生活，而不是像这里这样？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, good.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太好了。

sentences.en: Well, when I was here, I mean, there was a way to do it also.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实我在这里的时候，也有办法过那种生活。

sentences.en: I mean, it depends what kind of place you go to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这取决于你去什么样的地方。

sentences.en: You know how it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道是怎么回事。

sentences.en: And there, I can do everything.
sentences.zh: 而在那里，我可以做任何事。

sentences.en: I can, you know, go to school, go to the supermarket, go to a public gym,
sentences.zh: 我可以，你知道，去学校，去超市，去公共健身房，

sentences.en: go to everywhere, everywhere.
sentences.zh: 去任何地方，任何地方。

sentences.en: And this is what I want.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想要的。

sentences.en: I could not give up having a normal life.
sentences.zh: 我无法放弃拥有正常生活的权利。

sentences.en: Wait, you can go to a public gym?
sentences.zh: 等等，你可以去公共健身房？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And I can go everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我可以去任何地方。

sentences.en: And even if they do recognize you, do they treat celebrity with such reverence there like they do here?
sentences.zh: 即使他们认出了你，他们在那边对待名人的态度会像这里一样充满敬畏吗？

sentences.en: I think it's a little too big here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这里有点太夸张了。

sentences.en: No, I think it's not a surprise to see us there.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得在那里看到我们并不稀奇。

sentences.en: And also, everything ends up being close to the area where I grew up.
sentences.zh: 而且，一切最终都离我长大的地方很近。

sentences.en: And it feels like if you knew all your neighbors.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像认识所有的邻居一样。

sentences.en: You know, it feels very easygoing and people are very nice.
sentences.zh: 你知道，感觉非常轻松自在，人们也非常友善。

sentences.en: And is Javier from the same area?
sentences.zh: 哈维尔也是同一个地方的人吗？

sentences.en: He was actually born in Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 他其实出生在加那利群岛。

sentences.en: But he was raised more in the city.
sentences.zh: 但他更多是在城市里长大的。

sentences.en: And I was raised more out of Madrid.
sentences.zh: 而我更多是在马德里郊外长大的。

sentences.en: But also in L.A., I had no problems where I lived here.
sentences.zh: 不过在洛杉矶时，我住的地方也没什么问题。

sentences.en: And I feel like it's more like choosing where you go to.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这更多取决于你选择去哪里。

sentences.en: If you're going to go to a place looking for attention or you go to a place so you can live your day.
sentences.zh: 如果你去一个寻求关注的地方，或者你去一个能让你过好自己一天的地方。

sentences.en: And it's the vibe you put out too, right?
sentences.zh: 而且这也取决于你散发出的氛围，对吧？

sentences.en: And also what you wear too.
sentences.zh: 还有你的穿着。

sentences.en: Like if you look all great and fabulous or if you look like you're trying to hide with a hat and big glasses, people, you stand out like a sword.
sentences.zh: 比如如果你打扮得光鲜亮丽，或者你戴着帽子和大墨镜试图躲藏，人们，你就像一把剑一样显眼。

sentences.en: Draw more attention.
sentences.zh: 反而更引人注目。

sentences.en: Yeah, but if you just like there's no hiding whatsoever, it's just a little sweatshirt or something.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但如果你只是，根本不躲藏，就穿件小卫衣之类的。

sentences.en: Well, we had a guest on, one of our guests who's a friend of the show, I won't name him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们曾有一位嘉宾，是我们节目的朋友，我就不提他的名字了。

sentences.en: But he had, years ago, I'd gone to his house.
sentences.zh: 但他，几年前，我去过他家。

sentences.en: One of the biggest film actors on the planet.
sentences.zh: 他是这个星球上最伟大的电影演员之一。

sentences.en: And we went to his house and he said, and I was giving him a lift home.
sentences.zh: 我们去了他家，他说，当时我正开车送他回家。

sentences.en: And we get to his gate that was barely like a gate.
sentences.zh: 我们到了他的大门口，那根本算不上什么大门。

sentences.en: And then he said, just punching the code.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，直接输入密码就行。

sentences.en: I said, what's the code for the 2468?
sentences.zh: 我说，2468的密码是什么？

sentences.en: I said, come on, man.
sentences.zh: 我说，拜托，老兄。

sentences.en: And then you could walk around it if you want.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你想的话，完全可以绕过去。

sentences.en: We get up to his house and we walk in and the front door is open.
sentences.zh: 我们走到他家门口，走进去发现前门开着。

sentences.en: And I said, dude, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 我说，伙计，你在干什么？

sentences.en: You're crazy.
sentences.zh: 你疯了吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this is guys like that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是那种人。

sentences.en: And he goes, I don't live like a prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他说，我可不想像囚犯一样生活。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And if I put that vibe out in the world.
sentences.zh: 如果我向世界传递那种氛围的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, it's true.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，确实如此。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Probably take less attention like that.
sentences.zh: 那样可能反而受到的关注更少。

sentences.en: I totally, by the way, totally agree.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我完全同意。

sentences.en: I'm like, if somebody is going to get me, they're going to get me.
sentences.zh: 我就想，如果有人要找我麻烦，他们总会找到的。

sentences.en: Well, why do you have that?
sentences.zh: 那，你为什么还要那个？

sentences.en: You have that sign that says Sean Hayes lives here in front of your house.
sentences.zh: 你家门前立着个牌子，写着肖恩·海耶斯住在这里。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I mean, you can see behind some hedges.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但我的意思是，你可以从一些树篱后面看到。

sentences.en: Listen, Penelope, before we go any further, I want to ask you,
sentences.zh: 听着，佩内洛普，在我们继续之前，我想问你一个问题，

sentences.en: and this is a tough question and you can feel free to not answer it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很难的问题，你可以选择不回答。

sentences.en: We can always cut it out.
sentences.zh: 我们随时可以剪掉。

sentences.zh: 皇家马德里还是马德里竞技？

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: You don't care.
sentences.zh: 你根本不在乎。

sentences.en: I know that.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.zh: 我是说，我是在乎的，因为当你成为母亲后，有些事情会改变，

sentences.en: and suddenly you see they like football.
sentences.zh: 突然间你发现他们喜欢足球。

sentences.en: But then you start loving football too.
sentences.zh: 然后你也开始热爱足球了。

sentences.en: And I have a family that is from Atletico, family from Barcelona,
sentences.zh: 我的家人里有支持马竞的，有支持巴萨的，

sentences.en: club family from Real Madrid.
sentences.zh: 还有支持皇马的。

sentences.en: And I think they're amazing teaMs.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们都是很棒的球队。

sentences.en: But I am loving everything more.
sentences.zh: 但我现在对一切都更有好感了。

sentences.en: Real Madrid, what can I say?
sentences.zh: 皇家马德里，我能说什么呢？

sentences.en: Very, very good.
sentences.zh: 非常，非常棒。

sentences.en: I love, I'm a huge football fan and I'm obsessed and actually like both those teams as well.
sentences.zh: 我热爱足球，我是个超级球迷，我非常痴迷，其实我也喜欢这两支球队。

sentences.en: They have great players.
sentences.zh: 他们都有很棒的球员。

sentences.en: We're recording this right around the holiday season.
sentences.zh: 我们录制这段节目的时间正好在假期前后。

sentences.en: And are you a big holiday fan?
sentences.zh: 你是个喜欢过节的人吗？

sentences.en: Do you love Christmas?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢圣诞节吗？

sentences.en: Or I don't know what you guys celebrate.
sentences.zh: 或者我不知道你们庆祝什么节日。

sentences.en: Do you guys go skiing?
sentences.zh: 你们会去滑雪吗？

sentences.en: Do you like the beach instead?
sentences.zh: 还是说你们更喜欢去海滩？

sentences.en: It's just about being with the family.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了和家人在一起。

sentences.en: And since I have my kids, I really see, I get to experience again Christmas like when I was little.
sentences.zh: 自从有了孩子，我真的发现，我又可以像小时候那样重新体验圣诞节了。

sentences.en: And it's like having a second chance like to experience it, to experience that magic.
sentences.zh: 就像获得了第二次机会去体验它，去体验那种魔力。

sentences.en: And it's incredible.
sentences.zh: 这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I love it again so much.
sentences.zh: 我又重新爱上它了。

sentences.en: For a few years, it was just like one more part of the year.
sentences.zh: 有那么几年，它就像一年中平平无奇的一部分。

sentences.en: But now it's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 但现在它成了一件大事。

sentences.en: It's become a big deal.
sentences.zh: 它已经变成了一件大事。

sentences.zh: 我三岁的儿子今天早上说他想要那个卡车。

sentences.en: It was like a crane thing.
sentences.zh: 就像那种起重机玩具。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, well, we'll see if Santa comes.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我们看看圣诞老人会不会来。

sentences.en: And he goes, no, you buy it.
sentences.zh: 结果他说，不，是你买。

sentences.en: And I said, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，不，不。

sentences.en: We're going to see if Santa goes.
sentences.zh: 我们要看看圣诞老人会不会来。

sentences.en: Dada, you buy it.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你买。

sentences.en: But how old?
sentences.zh: 但他多大了？

sentences.en: How old is he?
sentences.zh: 他几岁了？

sentences.en: He's three and a half.
sentences.zh: 他三岁半了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Now, what do you think is too old to be still in the Santa world?
sentences.zh: 那么，你觉得多大就不该再相信圣诞老人的世界了？

sentences.en: I'm saying this gently because I don't know how young our listeners are.
sentences.zh: 我说话得委婉点，因为我不知道我们的听众里有没有小孩。

sentences.en: I feel it's when they're ready.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这取决于他们什么时候准备好了。

sentences.en: Yeah, when they're ready.
sentences.zh: 没错，等他们准备好了。

sentences.en: When they're ready, when they're ready.
sentences.zh: 等他们准备好了，等他们准备好了。

sentences.en: And maybe your son is ready now.
sentences.zh: 也许你儿子现在就准备好了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: It's a little shocking.
sentences.zh: 这有点让人震惊。

sentences.en: But when they're ready, they're going to ask in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但当他们准备好时，他们会用另一种方式来问。

sentences.en: He doesn't think that I'm Santa.
sentences.zh: 他并不是觉得我就是圣诞老人。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: He's just saying that he doesn't want to wait for Santa.
sentences.zh: 他只是说他不想等圣诞老人了。

sentences.en: Look at this guy.
sentences.zh: 看看这小家伙。

sentences.en: Look at this guy.
sentences.zh: 看看这小家伙。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: Adorable.
sentences.zh: 太可爱了。

sentences.en: Was he on the potty there?
sentences.zh: 他当时是在坐便盆吗？

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: He's on the potty.
sentences.zh: 他正在坐便盆。

sentences.en: He looks very excited about his movement.
sentences.zh: 他看起来对自己的排泄成果很兴奋。

sentences.en: Daddy, look.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你看。

sentences.en: Believe me, he's...
sentences.zh: 相信我，他……

sentences.en: I asked him this morning also.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上也问了他。

sentences.en: I'm not going to get to it in the week, but I asked him, who's the boss?
sentences.zh: 我这周没时间细说，但我问他，谁才是老大？

sentences.en: And he said, me.
sentences.zh: 他说，我。

sentences.en: I said, you're not the boss.
sentences.zh: 我说，你才不是老大。

sentences.en: Anyway.
sentences.zh: 总之。

sentences.en: I remember in Christmas, like my mom used to get us so much more in debt than we already were.
sentences.zh: 我记得小时候过圣诞节，我妈总是让我们背上比原来更多的债。

sentences.en: Christmas was like the number one thing in her life.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节就像她生命中最重要的事情。

sentences.en: Like, she would max out her credit cards and mortgage the house just so we could have presents.
sentences.zh: 她会刷爆信用卡，甚至抵押房子，就为了让我们有礼物收。

sentences.en: And as I got older, I'm like, I don't know if this is the greatest business model for our home.
sentences.zh: 等我长大后，我心想，不知道这对于我们家来说是不是最好的经营模式。

sentences.en: You're leaving us with another gift, too, Mom.
sentences.zh: 妈，你还给我们留下了另一份“礼物”呢。

sentences.en: That's debt.
sentences.zh: 那就是债务。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, by the way, it's a very sort of, it's very much symbolic of like sort of the age that we live in.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这在很大程度上象征着我们所处的这个时代。

sentences.en: You watch these ads now on TV and they're all like, everybody's going to go to one of these big box stores and they're like, well, dad needs a CD player.
sentences.zh: 你现在看电视上的广告，全都是那种，每个人都要去大型连锁超市，然后他们会说，爸爸需要一个CD播放机。
